tool_input.description: Write toWellFormed implementation and build the engine

result:
I implemented `String.prototype.toWellFormed` in its one allowed file, but I could not build it or run the test262 tests. The Bash tool was denied, so the code has only been checked by reading the engine source.

The implementation follows the spec steps as comments. It uses the same `CodePointAt` approach as the sibling built-ins, and it builds the result as UTF-16 and returns it with `agent.intern`. The `CodePointAt` and `UTF16EncodeCodePoint` helpers are private to the file, since the other built-ins keep their own copies. The unused `args` parameter is renamed `_args`.

Still to run: `cargo build -p kahvi-cli`, `cargo clippy`, and `./t262 built-ins/String/prototype/toWellFormed/`. The 8 target tests have not been run against this change.
